class.name: VisualShaderNodeStaticSwitch
class.brief_description: A compile-time switch that can be toggled per [MaterialInstance].
class.description: Outputs the [code]true[/code] input when the static switch [member switch_name] is enabled, and the [code]false[/code] input otherwise. Unlike [VisualShaderNodeSwitch], the choice is made when the shader is compiled, so the unused branch is removed from the shader variant. Several nodes can share the same [member switch_name]. The switch is set per material with [method MaterialInstance.set_static_switch], or in the [MaterialInstance] inspector.

members.member: Value of the switch for materials that don't override it.
The type of the inputs and output.
Name of the static switch. Must be a valid identifier.

constants.constant: Represents the size of the [enum OpType] enum.
